about: MENVA Instagram calendar, season three: 100 more days, continuing straight after calendar-2.json. Read by the n8n workflow. Edit, then run: node social/scripts/check-calendar.mjs social/content/calendar-3.json. Days around the expected Ashura dates (9-10 Muharram) carry a "note" flagging them for review and are kept calm/non-promotional. No post on 9-10 Muharram (Ashura, expected around 14-15 June 2027): the Ashura-day post was removed on review. Muharram 1-10 (days 45-54) is kept quiet: no sales posts or jokes (moved or removed on review).
